        SUM(bs.runs_scored) + COALESCE(SUM(er.extra_runs), 0) as total_runs

    LEFT JOIN extra_runs er ON bs.match_id = er.match_id 
        AND bs.over_id = er.over_id 
        AND bs.ball_id = er.ball_id
        AND bs.innings_no = er.innings_no

        b.match_id,
        b.over_id,
        b.bowler,
        SUM(bs.runs_scored + er.extra_runs) as bowler_runs

    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id

        AND b.over_id = er.over_id 
        AND b.ball_id = er.ball_id
